verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into his Cannon-stance poke all lane; you win if you force every fight into melee range.

brief.thesis: Jayce's real threat is Cannon-stance Shock Blast poke plus an Acceleration Gate boosting its speed and damage — he has no hard escape beyond Thundering Blow's 240-range knockback and Q's own leap in Hammer stance. Once Illaoi closes with W (Harsh Lesson, 400 range, 4s cooldown) and lands E (Test of Spirit, 900 range), the fight happens in melee where tentacles and passive healing overwhelm him. That's why this sits at an even 50% win rate over 114 games despite Illaoi holding lane and solo-kill advantage: she wins by surviving to melee, not by winning the poke war.

theirWindow.when: Jayce in Cannon stance, Acceleration Gate placed
theirWindow.what: He can fire a boosted Shock Blast through the gate for extra range, speed, and damage while staying safe — don't stand in its line, farm from max range, and let Doran's Shield sustain absorb the chip.

yourWindow.when: Jayce swaps to Hammer and leaps in with Q
yourWindow.what: Immediately E (Test of Spirit, 900 range) to rip his spirit and start the echo damage, then follow with W (Harsh Lesson, 4s cooldown) to close the gap and stack tentacle swings on him before he can disengage.

start.why: 56.9% win rate over 72 games — the sustain and damage reduction on autos directly answers Shock Blast chip while you farm through the poke phase.

boots.why: 51% win rate, 81.7% pick — Jayce's damage is physical (Shock Blast, Thundering Blow autos), so the flat reduction cuts his poke harder than Mercury's Treads.

core.why: First item on the highest-pick path (15.2%) — the slow on-hit and extra armor help you actually catch him once you've closed with W.
Second on the same build path — armor shred compounds the melee advantage once Test of Spirit forces the fight close.
Caps the core build (50% win rate, 12 games) — the shield and tenacity let you survive Thundering Blow's knockback and finish the engage.

his magic damage from Hammer form Lightning Field and R transform bonus damage starts adding up
you want faster healing off landed crits to win extended melee trades

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-pick page for this matchup (54.5% win rate, 33.9% pick) — the sustain lets you farm through his poke range exactly as OP.GG's own read on this matchup recommends, instead of forcing bad trades at range.

summoners.why: Flash + Teleport carries the best win rate in this matchup (55% over the sample) — it lets you reset after winning a melee exchange and get back to lane or siege, which suits Illaoi's win condition of out-lasting the poke phase rather than all-inning early.

playing.title: Dodge the gate poke
playing.detail: Stay off the line of any placed Acceleration Gate — a Shock Blast fired through it gains extra range, speed, and damage. Farm from max range and let Doran's Shield absorb the rest.

playing.title: Punish Hammer-stance engages
playing.detail: The instant Jayce swaps to Hammer and jumps in with Q (To the Skies!), E him immediately to start the spirit echo, then W in to stack tentacle swings before he can reset.

playing.title: Force the Vessel
playing.detail: Once E has ripped his spirit, stay close enough that he can't outrun it — killing the spirit or keeping him tethered turns him into a Vessel spawning extra tentacles against him.

playing.title: Read the stance, not the cooldown
playing.detail: Hammer stance means a short-range leap and knockback are live; Cannon stance means pure poke and an attack-speed burst from Hyper Charge. Every swap resets what he can actually do to you.

playing.title: All-in the moment R is up
playing.detail: From level 6, R (Leap of Faith, 450 range) spawns a tentacle for every champion hit on landing — look to use it the instant he's inside your W leap range.

playing.title: Itemize to end fights fast
playing.detail: Plated Steelcaps into Iceborn Gauntlet, Black Cleaver, Sterak's Gage adds the armor and shred needed to close out melee trades before his knockback can create distance.

playing.title: Pull and farm, don't trade at range
playing.detail: Grasp sustain plus Doran's Shield is built to let you absorb his poke while farming — match OP.GG's own read on this matchup and avoid auto-trading him at max range.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning, timings, and trade patterns are this brief's own tactical analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Pull and farm lane in order to prevent being poked at, while keeping his (E)-(Q) in check by positioning yourself properly. When Jayce closes in with (Q), counterplay by using [E] immediately and deal damage. Although it is difficult to deal with ranged attacks, keep in mind that Illaoi is stronger in melee fights.
